preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[0].split()) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1].split())
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^9).
The second line contains exactly n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ m).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= int(stdin.split()[0].split()[1]) for a in stdin.split()[1].split())
preconditions.description: Each video size aᵢ satisfies 1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ m.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible time required to watch all n videos, where min_possible_time(n, m, a) is the smallest integer T such that there exists a schedule of downloads and watches satisfying the constraints.
